gloss: to belong to, to be part of

definitions.gloss: to belong to, to be affiliated with, to be part of
definitions.explanation: To be a member of or fall under a particular group, organization, or category.

examples.japanese: サッカー{部|ぶ}に{属|ぞく}している。
examples.english: I belong to the soccer club.

examples.japanese: この{島|しま}は{日本|にほん}の{領土|りょうど}に{属|ぞく}する。
examples.english: This island belongs to Japanese territory.

examples.japanese: パンダは{哺乳類|ほにゅうるい}に{属|ぞく}する{動物|どうぶつ}で、{主|おも}に{竹|たけ}を{食|た}べて{生活|せいかつ}している。
examples.english: Pandas are animals belonging to the mammal class and mainly live by eating bamboo.

notes:
USAGE:
{属|ぞく}する is a formal verb meaning to belong to a group, organization, or classification. It takes the particle に to mark the group one belongs to. In everyday speech, the more casual expressions ～に{入|はい}っている or ～の{一員|いちいん}だ are often preferred.

PATTERNS:
- ～に{属|ぞく}する: to belong to ~
- ～に{属|ぞく}している: to be belonging to ~ (current state)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {組織|そしき}に{属|ぞく}する: to belong to an organization
- {部門|ぶもん}に{属|ぞく}する: to belong to a department
- {分類|ぶんるい}に{属|ぞく}する: to belong to a classification
